messages:
maya_cs: heads-up — Sparkline Analytics onboarding flagged by ops: tail latency spikes on /v1/generate during batch hours (08:00-11:00 PDT). Observed p95 ~820ms, p99 ~2.1s, throughput ~35-45 qps. :thinking_face:
jon_eng: thanks — any repro prompts or traffic shape?
maya_cs: mostly long-summary flows, avg seq_len ~512, some single-shot summarization and a few multi-turn chat prompts. They use gpt-neoX-20b-fp16 currently on Dedicated pools.
liam_ml: rough guess: big model + long seqs + small batch sizes => kernel startup + KV cache pressure. Can push latency down by: 1) quantizing to int8 or q4_0 for that model 2) swapping to a compact 7b variant for tail-sensitive routes 3) region-based routing to their west-coast pool.
jon_eng: +1. Do we have a verified compact that keeps quality? We need quick A/B plan.
sarah_se: they care about extractive summary accuracy — business-critical. They want <1% regression on the prompt set. We have the Sparkline-critical-20 eval set from onboarding tests.
liam_ml: propose this sequence: step A) enable per-route routing to west region (low-risk), step B) canary quantization on a copy of the model with automatic fallback, step C) optional model-swap to redwood-compact-7b-int8 if quantization fails quality gates. Canary sizes: 5% quantization, monitor latency + quality for 48h, rollback on >0.8% quality drop or latency worsening.
maya_cs: ops asked for measurable rollback criteria and a simple runbook they can follow. Can you draft the commands and who owns rollout?
jon_eng: I'll own implementation. Patch will include a route config like:
```
route: /v1/generate
policy:
  - region: us-west-2
    percent: 90
  - region: us-east-1
    percent: 10
canary_quant: 5%
model_variants:
  - gpt-neox-20b-fp16
  - gpt-neox-20b-q4_0 (canary)
```
jon_eng: Alerting hooks to wire: p95/p99 latency, per-prompt quality score (embedding cosine vs baseline), error-rate, and a regression alert if quality_delta < -0.8% over rolling 1000 requests.
liam_ml: eval steps: run Sparkline-critical-20 against q4_0 artifact, measure Rouge-L + domain heuristics. If QE pass, up canary to 25% then 50%. If fail, try redwood-compact-7b-int8 on 5% and compare both.
sarah_se: I'll coordinate customer-facing comms and hold the prompt set. Also collecting their acceptance criteria (legal/compliance ok with quantized weights).
maya_cs: ops wants one-pager + runbook and owner names. Jon, can you drop the playbook here by EOD?
jon_eng: will do. I'll also add a small script to toggle canary percentages and a dashboard link.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-config patch queued by jon_eng at 3141592700.
maya_cs: perfect — I'll schedule a 30min sync with Sparkline (tomorrow 10am PT) to review plan. :calendar:
liam_ml: follow-ups: 1) add latency tail smoothing (prefetch KV cache) 2) check batcher settings (increase batching window slightly during peak) 3) confirm model quantization reproducibility.
jon_eng: noted. I'll attach the draft playbook here after the patch is in QA.
sarah_se: tagging @legal for model artifact approval.
maya_cs: thanks all — this should reduce p99 and give us a safe path to lower cost if they accept compact model. Will update after sync.
